feat(inari): add Authentik SSO stack

Integrate authentik-nix, enable Authentik with PostgreSQL and a dedicated Redis instance, and expose authentik.wolfhard.net via nginx + ACME. Add deployment and post-setup documentation for secrets, OIDC, and LDAP outpost configuration.

perf(nix): increase download buffer size

style(tailscale): fix firewall option indentation

feat(doom): add comprehensive Git/GitHub tooling & keybindings

Packages added:
- consult-gh: interactive GitHub CLI interface (repos, issues, PRs, code search)
- difftastic: structural, syntax-aware diffs appended to magit-diff transient

Bug fixes:
- magit-delta: fix wrong variable name (magit-delta-default-options →
  magit-delta-delta-args) and replace invalid args with --color-only;
  this restores hunk staging compatibility with magit

New configurations (previously installed but unconfigured):
- blamer: GitLens-style inline blame, colour matched to doom theme comments face
- forge: topic list limits + authinfo setup instructions in comments
- git-link: commit-hash URLs (stable across branch renames)
- consult-gh: preview enabled, clone directory ~/projects/
- gh-notify: 48h notification window
- magit-todos: extended keyword list (TODO/FIXME/HACK/REVIEW/NOTE/DEPRECATED/BUG)
- embark-vc, consult-ls-git, consult-ghq: loaded after their dependencies
- smerge-mode: auto-activate on files with conflict markers

Keybindings added under SPC g (avoiding all Doom defaults):
  SPC g a/A   blamer toggle / blame popup
  SPC g M *   merge conflict prefix (smerge: next/prev/keep-mine/theirs/resolve/ediff)
  SPC g o l/L git-link permalink / commit permalink  (extends SPC g o)
  SPC g l g/G consult-ls-git files  (extends SPC g l)
  SPC g h *   GitHub prefix: consult-gh search + gh-notify notifications
  SPC g q/Q   consult-ghq jump / grep across repos

Magit quality settings:
  magit-diff-refine-hunk = all  (word-level diffs in every hunk)

feat: add diff subcommand with rename detection (T-30)

Implements `git-closure diff <left.gcl> <right.gcl>` with:

  A  <path>                  — file added in right
  D  <path>                  — file removed from left
  M  <path>                  — same path, content changed
  R  <old>  ->  <new>        — same content, path changed (rename)
  --json                     — machine-readable JSON output

Exit semantics: exit 0 if identical, exit 1 if any differences found.

Algorithm (O(n log n)):
1. Build HashMap<path, SnapshotFile> for left and right.
2. Walk left: absent in right → removed candidate; different sha256 → modified.
3. Walk right: absent in left → added candidate.
4. Rename detection: build reverse index sha256 → [new_paths] over added
   candidates; match each removed candidate by sha256 (deterministically
   picking the lex-smallest new path).  Matched pairs are emitted as
   Renamed and excluded from Removed/Added.
5. Symlinks use "symlink:<target>" as their content key (sha256 is always
   empty for symlinks, so a plain sha256 match would be wrong).

Output ordering: renames first (by new path), then removed, added,
modified — each group lexicographically sorted.

`pub` via lib.rs re-exports.  `snapshot/diff.rs` carries 7 unit tests.
